summary: Phase 5 (Riwayat Pembayaran QRIS + filter tanggal + unduh CSV + notifikasi admin + SMTP skip) tested end-to-end. Backend pytest: 11/11 PASS (test_phase5_qris.py). Covers: GET /api/orders/admin/pembayaran-qris list all (seeds ORD-SEED-A & ORD-SEED-B present), filter today only (returns ORD-SEED-A, excludes ORD-SEED-B), filter 2020 empty, auth required (401); CSV endpoint returns text/csv with Content-Disposition attachment, header 'Nomor Pesanan,Waktu Bayar,Nominal,Status,Kasera ID' + ORD-SEED-A row, filter applied, auth required; GET /api/orders/admin/notifikasi returns {count:2, items} (seeds admin_notif_qris=true), POST /admin/notifikasi/baca marks all read (count->0), auth required; GET /api/settings/public exposes qris_merchant. Frontend (Playwright, owner login via /masuk cookie-based auth): /admin/pembayaran-qris loads riwayat-qris-page; initial Count=2, Total=Rp 7.500.000, 2 riwayat-row-* rendered; after fill filter-start=filter-end=today + btn-apply-filter -> 1 row (ORD-SEED-A); btn-download-csv triggers real browser download (pembayaran-qris.csv). Header lonceng btn-notif shows notif-badge '2'; opens notif-panel; btn-notif-read empties badge; notif-lihat-semua navigates to /admin/pembayaran-qris. SMTP intentionally not configured (SMTP_HOST empty) - email send properly skipped, no backend errors, QRIS flow + settings endpoint healthy.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_orders._ambil_pembayaran_qris filters qris_paid_at by lexicographic string compare (start+'T00:00:00' / end+'T23:59:59.999999'). Works because qris_paid_at is stored as ISO string with +00:00 offset so sort is monotonically correct. Fragile if a document ever gets stored with a different tz (e.g. +07:00) — lex compare would misclassify. Nice-to-have: parse into datetime for comparison or require storage normalization.

CSV endpoint uses csv module with default dialect and no BOM. Opening pembayaran-qris.csv in Excel ID locale with Unicode nomor pesanan is fine for ASCII seeds, but future orders with non-ASCII customer data would benefit from utf-8-sig BOM for Excel.
GET /admin/notifikasi hard-caps at 50 docs without pagination; acceptable for a bell indicator but could miss older unread items in extreme cases.

email_service is_configured() short-circuit is good; however mark_order_paid wraps send in try/except — ensure it logs the exception path so misconfigured SMTP future failures are visible (not silently swallowed).

success_rate.frontend: 100% - filter + CSV + notifikasi flows all pass
